en_before: OOTD stands for 'Outfit of the Day': the look you wear on a particular day. For details about OOTD meaning, where people post their looks and how daily outfit photos help develop personal style, see the dedicated guide what OOTD means. On Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, an OOTD usually shows what someone actually wears for coffee, school, work, an evening out or a photo walk.
